title: WatchBox Service Record Failure Rate
dataSources: Chrono24 listings (`chrono24:listing`), WatchBox service records (`watchbox:service`), wrist-time logs (`watch:wristtime`), and watch service history (`watch:service`).
app: Chrono24 listing snapshots, WatchBox service records, wrist-time wear logs, and in-house service history exports ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=watchbox:service
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(service_status,"unknown"))
| eval failed=if(match(status_value,"error|fail|alert|overdue|late|stale|breach"),1,0)
| stats count as events, sum(failed) as failed_events by service_type
| eval failure_pct=round(100*failed_events/events,1)
| sort - failure_pct - failed_events
description: Measures how often WatchBox service record records land in an unhealthy or exception state for each service type.
value: A plain failure-rate view highlights noisy devices, flaky automations, and habits that repeatedly slip.
implementation: Normalize service_status values into good or bad states and review the failure percentage per service type.
visualization: Bar chart of failure percentage by entity.
grandmaExplanation: It highlights which parts of your WatchBox service record data keep ending up in a bad state instead of working cleanly.
